An edited comment is marked by a nullable `editedAt` timestamp. It stays null until the first edit, and each successful edit sets it to the time of that edit. The migration that adds the field must not change existing rows.

The release checklist also applies: run `npx prisma migrate deploy` against a fresh database before shipping, and include a one-line note saying how to undo the migration.
